जाने-माने फिल्म निर्माता और दिग्गज अभिनेत्री मौसमी चटर्जी के पति जयंत मुखर्जी का 12 नवंबर को निधन हो गया 🕯️
FWICE के अध्यक्ष BN Tiwari के मुताबिक उनका निधन मुंबई के खार स्थित आवास पर उम्र से जुड़ी समस्याओं के कारण हुआ 🏠
रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार उनकी तबीयत कुछ समय से ठीक नहीं चल रही थी और स्वास्थ्य बिगड़ने के बाद उनका निधन हुआ 📉
वे दिग्गज गायक-संगीतकार हेमंत कुमार के बेटे थे और उन्होंने Mazaaq, Do Ladke Dono Kadke जैसी फिल्मों में बतौर निर्माता काम किया था 🎬
जयंत और मौसमी की शादी 1972 में हुई थी और उनकी बड़ी बेटी Payal का निधन 2019 में हो गया था 😢
अब परिवार में उनकी पत्नी मौसमी और छोटी बेटी Megha हैं, जिनकी तरफ से अभी कोई आधिकारिक बयान नहीं आया है 🙏
क्या आपने इनकी कोई फिल्म देखी है? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताएं ⬇️

ctx.text:
Veteran film producer Jayanta Mukherjee, husband of actor Moushumi Chatterjee and son of legendary singer-composer Hemant Kumar, passed away on November 12 in Mumbai. He was in his late 70s and had reportedly been unwell for some time. His demise was confirmed by BN Tiwari, President of the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE).
Speaking to PTI, Tiwari said, "He passed away last evening due to age-related issues at his residence in Khar."
According to reports, Jayanta died at his residence after his health deteriorated. He had reportedly been dealing with age-related ailments for some time. The family has not yet shared a detailed public statement regarding his demise.
Jayanta Mukherjee worked behind the scenes in the entertainment industry as a film producer. His production credits included Mazaaq (1975), Do Ladke Dono Kadke (1979) and Biwi Aur Makan (1966). Both Mazaaq and Do Ladke Dono Kadke featured Moushumi Chatterjee in prominent roles. He was also associated with the television serial Talaash , which aired in 1992.
Coming from a family with a strong musical background, Jayanta was the son of Hemant Kumar, one of the most recognised singers and music composers in Indian cinema. He also had an association with the music department of Biwi Aur Makan .
Jayanta and Moushumi Chatterjee got married in 1972 and shared more than five decades together. The couple had two daughters, Payal and Megha. Their elder daughter, Payal Mukherjee, passed away in December 2019 at the age of 45 following health complications.
Jayanta is survived by his wife, Moushumi and younger daughter Megha.
